caption: The drawing depicts two ornamental objects rendered in black and white pencil or ink on a plain, off-white or yellowed background. The upper object is circular with a square, highly detailed floral design at its center, bordered by an array of raised patterns including leaves, flowers, and a central rounded dome. The decorative elements fill the interior and edges with intricate floral motifs, and the overall composition is enclosed within a lightly sketched rectangular frame. Below this object, connected by a vertical rod, is a pedestal-like base with an elongated, curved tray and four ornate feet, each adorned with scrolling patterns and decorative detailing. The entire drawing is precise and features fine line work to indicate texture and three-dimensional form. The artist’s signature, "Francis Law Durand," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Cake Dish
